# zbor source snapshot

Source: https://codeberg.org/r4gus/zbor (license in `license`).
Based on the `0.21.2` package used by Cloudio at upstream revision
`658c1c0ec607557b52d2e2a42acbfad31058ecee`, with Analytico's Zig compatibility
changes. Copied from the tracked tree of https://github.com/tzekid/analytico at
revision `3e123f2d3602fa0bbe51388d4da392daf6cce7c8` on 2026-10-17.
The library source, license, README, examples, and existing test data are vendored.
dbui bounds untrusted WebAuthn CBOR before calling this parser.
Trailing whitespace in the upstream README was removed.
